title: Nitrosation of dimethylamine by nitrite and activation of NDMA
compartment: Gastric lumen, then hepatocyte endoplasmic reticulum and nucleus

steps.note: pKa 3.3 to 3.4; about half of gastric nitrite is protonated

steps.enzyme: Acid-catalysed condensation of two HNO2, non-enzymatic
steps.note: Nitrosation rate rises with the square of nitrite; N2O3 also yields NO and NO2
Secondary amines give stable nitrosamines; primary amines decompose to N2
Mainly hepatic; competing CYP2E1 denitrosation yields methylamine
Unrepaired, it causes G to A transitions; MGMT removes the methyl group
